description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the distribution of three categories—“W/o Demos,” “Hard to Tell,” and “W/ Demos”—across three conditions (one unlabeled top chart, plus “Funny Reddit” and “Unhealthy Comments”), with a total of 3 slices per pie. A legend at the top maps colors to categories: light gray corresponds to “W/o Demos,” medium blue to “Hard to Tell,” and light green to “W/ Demos,” and each slice contains an internal percentage label. In the top pie chart, the light gray “W/o Demos” slice is 43.0%, the medium blue “Hard to Tell” slice is 22.9%, and the light green “W/ Demos” slice is 34.1%. In the “Funny Reddit” pie, light gray “W/o Demos” is 41.5%, medium blue “Hard to Tell” is 21.5%, and light green “W/ Demos” is 37.1%. In the “Unhealthy Comments” pie, light gray “W/o Demos” is 37.8%, medium blue “Hard to Tell” is 27.4%, and light green “W/ Demos” is 34.8%. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice ordering appears consistent across pies rather than explicitly sorted by size.
